slides.h: For the friend who says anime is silly: [[5 thrillers]] with zero power-ups.
slides.dek: Crime, paranoia, and time travel that plays fair. Pick any one, no homework required.

slides.title: Monster
slides.why: A doctor saves a child. The child grows up. A slow-burn manhunt written for adults.

slides.title: Steins;Gate
slides.why: A microwave starts sending texts to the past. Opens as comedy, tightens like a vice.

slides.title: Erased
slides.why: A man wakes up in his 11-year-old body with one murder to prevent. One tight season.

slides.title: Terror in Resonance
slides.why: Two teenagers announce their crimes in riddles. One detective takes them seriously.

slides.title: Paranoia Agent
slides.why: A whole city blames one skater for everything. From the director of Perfect Blue.

slides.body: Drop your pick below. Send this to the true crime friend.
